description_en: Terminates a Spark log analysis task and queries the information about the analysis task
description_zh: 终止一个Spark分析任务，返回尝试终止后的任务详情
name: KillSparkLogAnalyzeTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Spark log analysis task. You can call the ListSparkLogAnalyzeTasks operation to query the IDs and states of all analysis tasks in the current cluster
parameters.help_zh: Spark日志分析任务ID。可以通过调用ListSparkLogAnalyzeTasks查询当前集群中所有的分析任务的ID和状态
parameters.name: task_id
